title: Rabbits use a secret skeletal superpower to glide through dense grass
description: Discover the incredible biomechanics of how rabbits navigate dense meadow grass at high speeds to escape predators.
instagram_caption: Ever wonder how a rabbit moves so fast through thick grass? 🐇🌾 It’s not just speed—it’s pure physics and incredible skeletal design! Watch to see how they vanish in seconds. #wildlife #naturelovers #mechanics #animals

segments.narration: A rabbit hitting a wall of thick grass doesn't slow down; it bursts through the dense tangle at nearly forty miles an hour.
